name: Infiltration Package
text:
This augmentation replaces a hand.

This implant appears to be a standard cybernetic mechanical arm, but conceals a security kit and a slicer's kit. Additionally, you can also use an action to cast _release_ at 2nd level without expending tech points or use of a tech focus. Intelligence is your techcasting ability for this power. Once you've done so, you can't do so again until you complete a long rest.

**Side Effect:** This hand can no longer wield items that weigh more than 7 lbs.

_This fully cybernetic hand replacement contains a hidden array of infiltration tools optimized for defeating a wide variety of security barriers._
